meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可渲染的画面合成项目,用时间轴排好片段并校验输出。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做逐帧可复现的媒体合成并需要校验。
copy.tagline_en: Build renderable composition projects with clips, tracks, and validated output.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assemble frame-accurate compositions and need deterministic, validated renders.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 按 HyperFrames 契约写一个可渲染的 HTML 视频工程:用 data-* 属性声明时间、class="clip"、轨道与子合成,媒体播放由框架负责,并用 lint/check 校验。
howto.when: 当你准备编写 composition HTML,或要处理合成结构、data-* 计时属性、子合成等时,它就接管。

say.text: 帮我从最小的可渲染骨架开始搭一个 composition
say.note: 会按 minimal-composition 骨架生成

say.text: 给这个 clip 设置 data-start 和 data-duration
say.note: 会按时间窗口写入属性

say.text: 跑一遍 npx hyperframes check,清掉 lint 报错
say.note: 会列出问题并据此修改

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes one renderable HyperFrames HTML video project: data-* timing attributes, class="clip", tracks, sub-compositions and variables, framework-owned media playback, plus lint/check validation.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you are about to write composition HTML, or when a task involves composition structure, the data-* timing attributes, sub-compositions and similar topics.

say_en.text: Help me start from the smallest renderable composition skeleton
Set data-start and data-duration for this clip
Run npx hyperframes check and clear the lint errors
